definitions.explanation: A large formal meeting of a political party's members, held to decide policy, elect leaders, or set direction. A common term in political news.

examples.japanese: {党大会|とうたいかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A party convention is being held.

examples.japanese: {党大会|とうたいかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: A new leader was chosen at the party convention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{党大会|とうたいかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けた→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{示|しめ}された→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: At this year's party convention, the policy direction for next year's election was laid out.

notes:
Formed from {党|とう} (party) + ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (convention, large meeting). Refers to a political party's top decision-making assembly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {党大会|とうたいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a party convention
- {党大会|とうたいかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide at a party convention
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{党大会|とうたいかい}: an extraordinary (special) party convention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: convention; large gathering; tournament — the general word, not limited to politics.
- ⟦{総会|そうかい}→総会：13855_soukai⟧: general meeting — a general assembly of members of any organization.
